title: 皐月賞の後に・勝ちたかった

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: The whole time I was running, I felt a powerful tingling sensation. A kind of electricity that raced across my neck… my hands… my back… my legs…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Yaeno's ragged breaths and my own gasps echoed in my head.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: And my chest filled to bursting with the determination not to lose…

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: What an incredible race! And the winner is…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Huff… Puff…

text_block_list.name: Chiyono O & Yaeno
text_block_list.text: Waaaaah! Aaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: (Yaeno and I both scream, as if releasing all the pain inside of us.)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: (We both wanted to win. I think it's because, to us, beating your rival…)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: (…Means getting first.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: That's right. This is the reality of competition. That hair-raising cry of everything you are in this moment…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: When the time comes next, I will be there running alongside you. I will carve out my very own moment at the Derby.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: …Sniffle.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: …Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I lost… Even though I tried so hard to win… put in all that effort…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I still lost!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I… I…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Sniff. Hic!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: It hurts so muuuch! Waaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Sorry… I didn't mean to act in such an unsightly way…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I know this was just a single loss… Not such a big deal in the grand scheme of things…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: …Yet it still hurts so much.
choice_data_list: That's because you battled it out with everything you had.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Oh… That's right. This was a battle…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Sigh… I'm sorry!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I may have lost today, but I won't lose the Derby.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I don't care if I have to run against Yaeno again, or if Ardan pits everything she possibly can against me.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: My desire to win the Derby is stronger than anyone's.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Right!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Bzzzt… Bzzzt…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Huh? Dad? Why is he calling?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Thanks. Sorry to make you step out.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Hello? Dad?

text_block_list.name: Chiyono O's Father
text_block_list.text: Oh, Chiyo! You worked really hard on your recovery, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Hehe… Yeah. I'm almost completely better now. Oh, speaking of, about the tatami mats back at home—

text_block_list.name: Chiyono O's Father
text_block_list.text: I know. Your mother told me. You sure did a number on those poor mats.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Eugh… I'm so sorry…

text_block_list.name: Chiyono O's Father
text_block_list.text: Don't worry your little head. They're proof of your hard work.

text_block_list.name: Chiyono O's Father
text_block_list.text: I ruined a fair number of tatami mats back in my day too! You and I are peas in a pod! Hahaha!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Dad…

text_block_list.name: Chiyono O's Father
text_block_list.text: Chiyo, I heard you're going to compete in the Derby. Is there something special you want to accomplish there?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: …Yeah, there is.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: There's a dream I want to fulfill. A dream that someone I look up to entrusted to me.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: But I'm not the only racer who's devoted all my time and heart to winning.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: My rivals are just as determined not to lose to anyone.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: That's why the Derby is so important to me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Our next goal is her dream race—the Japanese Derby.
